title: Altair Semiconductor, an Israeli chipmaker spun off from Sony earlier in 2026, raised a $100M Series A, as it prepares to launch low-power cellular modems (CTech)
summary: CTech: Altair Semiconductor, an Israeli chipmaker spun off from Sony earlier in 2026, raised a $100M Series A, as it prepares to launch low-power cellular modems — The company, spun off from Sony earlier this year, is preparing a new low-power 5G modem for smart glasses, wearables and industrial devices.
